degree_plan_passages.text: Artificial Intelligence track. Students interested in machine learning, data science, deep learning, natural language processing and computer vision follow the AI track. Typical sequence: MATH201 and STAT201 in Year 2, AI301 Machine Learning Fundamentals in Year 3 together with AI310 Data Mining and AI320 Data Visualization, then AI401 Deep Learning, AI402 Natural Language Processing and AI403 Computer Vision in Year 4. Strong mathematics (linear algebra, probability) and Python programming are the foundation of this track.

Recommended core sequence. Year 1 core: CS101 Introduction to Programming, CS102 Discrete Mathematics, MATH101 Calculus I, ENG101 Technical Writing, PHYS101 Physics for Computing. Year 2 core: CS201 Data Structures, CS202 Object-Oriented Programming, CS203 Computer Organization, MATH201 Linear Algebra, STAT201 Probability and Statistics, CS210 Database Systems. Year 3 core: CS301 Algorithm Analysis, CS302 Operating Systems, CS310 Software Engineering, CS320 Computer Networks, AI301 Machine Learning Fundamentals. Year 4 core: CS410 Senior Project I and CS411 Senior Project II.
